author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
ChatGPT is hallucinating when I ask it to double check the price of a flight ticket quote that I got from the travel agent is really the cheapest. 

The quote is $900 and ChatGPT claims the cheapest is $200.  When I ask him to show me the proof, it apologizes that he just made up the price.
